chapter: Favorite bands, advice and family reflections
title: Favorite bands: Russell, Basie, Kirby, Kirk
summary: His favorite was Luis Russell, then Henderson; Basie was the best jump band after Russell.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: If you had to look back over your entire playing career and I asked you to pick or give me your favorite band from the whole thing, not from the '20s but all the way through.
Louis Russell.
Louis Russell would be one. Would you name all the other bands that you would place in this list of your favorites?
Louis Russell and ... and a little bit more of Fletcher Henderson but I can't get away from Louis Russell's band.
How about John Kirby?
John Kirby? Well, I never played with him. You were talking about the bands I was playing with?
No, all bands.
Oh, all bands. John Kirby had a little band; a good one, too. He had a great band. Of course, he was playing uptown and we were playing downtown.
Well, what /about a Count Basie's band? Where would you place that as far as on the scale?
Ever since I heard Count Basie's band, I always said he was the best jump band I ever heard, after Louis Russell. That's my opinion.
What about some of the other bands, people like Erskine Hawkins and Hot Lips Page and all these that have bands like that? Andy Kirk.
... I never did much ... I didn't hear the records but when we got the play back, they were (jumping back) and I have (..) but they were very good.
What did you think of his band? with
No, I recorded whith his band.
Did you like the band?
Yes, I did.
It was a good band?
Sure, it was.
What about Andy Kirk W.
Andy Kirk had a beautiful band. A good band.
What about Erskine Hawkins?
Right, right I was getting ready to get to that but you say Jimmy London. What did you think of that?
Loved it.
What about Erskine Hawkins?
OK.
When you think of Jimmy Lunsworth and Basie's band, something like that, what do you think of that?
I'd take Basie any time, any place.
